title: QR codes
description: A printed code always points at the same short address; the destination is changed here, with nothing reprinted.

search.placeholder: Search by name, code or destination

form.labelHelp: How you will recognise this code a year from now.
form.targetUrlHelp: Where a scan is sent. Change it whenever you like — that is the whole point of the system.
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Where it is stuck, who asked for it, how long it runs.
form.slugPlaceholder: Generated for you if left empty
form.slugHelp: Appears in the printed URL. Can only be chosen at creation.
form.slugLocked: The short code cannot be changed: it is already printed.
form.isActiveHelp: An inactive code stops redirecting but keeps every scan already recorded.
form.renderHelp: Only the fields you touch are saved; the rest stay as they were.
form.centerLogoHelp: The logo covers part of the symbol; error correction is what keeps it readable.
form.centerLogoNeedsCorrection: A centre logo does not fit at this error-correction level. Raise it to M, Q or H.

download.help: The image is drawn with this code's saved options.
download.failed: The image could not be generated.

messages.deleteError: The QR code could not be deleted
messages.deleteConfirm: Delete this code? The short code stays reserved forever and the recorded scans are kept.
messages.requiredLabel: The name is missing: it is what lets you find this code a year from now.
messages.requiredTargetUrl: The destination URL is missing: without it the code leads nowhere.
messages.invalid: Check the marked fields: something here the server will not accept.

urls.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.

utm.editHelp: Only these parameters are rewritten: the rest of the URL stays as it is. Leave a field empty to remove it.
utm.generatedHint: Computed from the listing: not editable here.
utm.seededHint: These are the UTMs the code adds on its own at scan. Saving a change writes them into the URL, and they replace the automatic ones.

tags.emptyCatalog: No tags yet. Create the first one from “Manage tags”.
tags.formHelp: Used to sort and filter the list. They do not change where the code leads.
tags.manageHelp: Renaming a tag changes it on every code that carries it. Deleting it does not touch the codes.
tags.createError: Could not create the tag. Does one with that name already exist?
tags.updateError: Could not update the tag. Does one with that name already exist?
tags.deleteConfirm: “{{name}}” stops showing on every code that carries it. The codes are not touched.
